para: .pmw{position:relative;aspect-ratio:340/210;overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:#1b2329;margin-bottom:12px}.pme{display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--mute);font-size:13px}.pt{position:absolute;width:75.294%;height:121.905%;max-width:none;user-select:none;pointer-events:none}.pt.osm{filter:invert(1) hue-rotate(180deg) brightness(.85) contrast(.9)}.pz{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(101,216,222,.15);border:1.5px solid rgba(101,216,222,.7)}.pa{position:absolute;width:34px;height:34px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid var(--mute);background-size:cover;background-position:center;display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.pa.home{border-color:var(--ok)}.pmz{position:absolute;right:8px;top:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.pmz button{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(15,32,45,.85);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--fg)}.pcr{position:absolute;right:6px;bottom:3px;font-size:9px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45)}
